atlas_report.coordinate_selection: Every longitude and intermediate latitude is an OSW editorial choice offshore of western India. Only the two approximate latitude contexts come from the 1991 abstract. No velocity axis, isobath, geographic current boundary or physical endpoint is measured.
atlas_report.layer: Poleward upper coastal current context; no fixed numerical sampling layer or current axis. Excludes the southward undercurrent and does not equate shallow shelf variability with the slope current.
atlas_report.map_land_check: All 3 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
atlas_report.method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
atlas_report.name: West India Coastal Current: winter regional reach
atlas_report.nasa_crop_recommendation_rule: Highest zoom crop covering the entire display route in every retained scenario, with tile ID as deterministic tie-break. No physical identification asserted.
